_doc: Budget for the API Worker's startup, enforced by scripts/ci/worker-startup-budget.mjs (CI: Worker dry-run (api)). Cloudflare rejects a deploy whose global scope exceeds its startup CPU limit (error 10021, hit once after the B2B merge). Local workerd numbers are not Cloudflare's, so these are REGRESSION gates with headroom over the recorded baseline, not the platform limit. Raise one only with a Ruling that says why. The absolute startupCpuMs ceiling is enforced on main/nightly runs (quiet runner); pull requests compare against main's bundle measured in the same job (relative.ratio + relative.slackMs).
_ruling: Ruling BUNDLE-BUDGET-10 (docs/rulings/BUNDLE-BUDGET-10.md): no ceiling moves; exceljs leaves worker.js as its own CommonJS module (7,486,993 B raw / 2,055,635 B gzip, 2026-11-11). Before that: Ruling BUNDLE-BUDGET-9 (docs/rulings/BUNDLE-BUDGET-9.md): no ceiling moves; the zod locales leave worker.js (7,808,831 B raw / 2,146,807 B gzip, 2026-11-09). Before that: Ruling BUNDLE-BUDGET-8 (docs/rulings/BUNDLE-BUDGET-8.md): the NEON-ZERO integration measures 8,018,344 B raw / 2,162,735 B gzip / 114.3 ms; the raw ceiling is raised to 8,300,000 B (gzip and CPU unchanged) until the Postgres client is removed (N-17). Before that: Ruling BUNDLE-BUDGET-7 (docs/rulings/BUNDLE-BUDGET-7.md): the integration of all open PRs measured 8,150,690 B raw; pdf-lib moved to its own Worker module (apps/api/src/cf/modules/pdf-lib.mjs) and worker.js measures 7,682,914 B. The ceilings stay at BUNDLE-BUDGET-5/6's 7,800,000 / 2,200,000; no raise.
